structuredContent.description: Single isolated BOSS METEOR sprite for Ash Warden, low top-down fantasy pixel-art game. An irregular chunky dark charcoal basalt rock with THREE broad readable stone facets, 34 pixels wide, centered at x58 y87 on a 128x128 transparent canvas. Two short warm orange molten fissures and a small pale gold leading edge. A tapered orange/copper flame tail points UP and slightly RIGHT from the rock toward x82 y28, so the rock falls DOWN-LEFT at about 67 degrees below horizontal. Three broad separated flame tongues, dark gaps, only two tiny ember pixels. Restrained flat palette charcoal #302d30, ash #5e5552, muted rust #99513a, copper #cf6839, amber #ee9d51, tiny pale gold #f1c97b. Bold silhouette, coarse clean pixel clusters, 2-3 shade levels. Heavier and larger than a mage projectile but not a giant screen-filling explosion. Keep clear margins. No magic circle, no ground, no smoke cloud, no text, no blur, no bloom, no photorealistic texture.
